title: Microsoft ML Road Detections
description: A cloud-native mirror of the road detections Microsoft mines from Bing Maps aerial imagery and publishes at [microsoft/RoadDetections](https://github.com/microsoft/RoadDetections). Microsoft distributes the data as nineteen zipped TSV files of GeoJSON, one per UN subregion. This catalog republishes the same roads as GeoParquet partitioned by country, so a reader can query one country, one bounding box, or the whole planet without downloading 67 GB first. Microsoft produces the data and licenses it under ODbL; this catalog only reformats and hosts it. Agents should start at the catalog agent guide, [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md), which records the query recipes and the traps.
